decision_states.ELIGIBLE_FOR_GOVERNANCE_REVIEW: All historical and live gates pass; requires explicit human/model governance approval.
decision_states.REJECTED_FOR_PRODUCTION: Fails locked holdout, dependence, role, or live-direction requirements.
decision_states.RESEARCH_ONLY: Fails one or more promotion gates or live evidence is immature.

notes: A correlation coefficient is not causal proof.
A percentage-point edge is not a predicted absolute return.
Long-horizon results with independent N < 15 are never promotion eligible.
A threshold event and a continuous predictor have different historical qualification rules.
Cross-market and cross-actor combination discoveries require a separately preregistered confirmation study before eligibility.
purpose: Define eligibility for human governance review. This policy never changes production weights automatically.
